CDIAL 12598 gives Prakrit suṇaï, Marwari suṇṇo and Gujarati suṇvũ 'hear'. The survey's suṇ-/huṇ- variants are analysed as the same stem with regional s > h and nasal variation; Turner also documents Poguli hunnu within this family, though that parallel is not independent proof of the Mewari development. Ordinary perfective endings receive reflex links; auxiliary-bearing responses and the different hāmḷ- stem are excluded.

The survey's baras/baraś/varaś agree in their vowel-broken r-sibilant cluster; use the year sense, not the rain sense. The single varś record is deferred because its retained cluster may reflect learned influence.
